entries.zh: 养育；扶养、养活（兼指抚养幼小）
entries.en: to sustain, nourish; to raise, bring up (offspring)
entries.notes: H栏「富」与M栏音写（第二音节合「養」义）及L栏 sustentar、criar 不合，疑字形误录；义从L、M两栏。

entries.zh: 奉养、供奉（西语指奉事天主圣父）；赡养供给
entries.en: to sustain God the Father; to provide for, support (supply the needs of)
entries.notes: M栏 siam 与第6条「贍」同音，H栏「賡」疑为「贍」形近误录；义取奉养、供奉天父。

entries.zh: 抵抗、抵御（敌人）；支撑坚守
entries.en: to resist, withstand (the enemy); to hold out, sustain oneself
entries.notes: M栏第二音节 tu 对应汉字未确（疑「禦」类抗敌字）；「抵」与西语 resistencia 对应明确。

entries.zh: 养饲；饲养、抚育（幼儿幼畜）
entries.en: to raise and feed (the young); to rear, nourish offspring
to supply, provide for; to sustain

entries.zh: 赡老；奉养老人（赡养父母尊长）
entries.en: to provide for the aged; to support one's old parents
entries.notes: L栏作 sustentar a dios P.re，与「赡老」对应松散，「dios」疑沿第2条词头；释义以汉栏为准。

entries.zh: 为家；养家、当家（支撑家计）
entries.en: to keep house; to support and maintain a household

entries.zh: 供膳；供给膳食（子奉父、弟子奉师）
entries.en: to provide food and board for (one's father or master); to feed and support

entries.zh: 捍命；保住性命、维持生命
entries.en: to sustain or defend one's life; to keep alive
entries.notes: L栏释义残损难复原（[残]，maich 等词不明），首音节声调污损（T99）；「捍命」与「活命」二解并存，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 养成；养育成人（养至成立）
entries.en: to bring up to maturity; to raise until established

entries.zh: 细小之物；纤细微小的东西
entries.en: a fine, small thing; something delicate and tiny
entries.notes: H栏字形未定（[疑:灣/瀾]，均与义不合），M栏 poj 对应汉字未能确证；义从西语词头 sutil。

entries.zh: 玄微；幽深精微（微妙细小）
entries.en: subtle and minute; profound, mysterious subtlety
entries.notes: M栏后半 suy suy 对应汉字未确（疑「細細」类叠音）；「玄微」与西语 sutil 对应明确。

entries.zh: 原；本来固有的（原其所有、天性本然）
entries.en: original, innate; one's own by nature

entries.notes: 仅M栏声调记号污损（T99）；音节与「伊个」及西语 suyo 对应明确。

entries.zh: 许个；那个人的（彼者之物）
entries.en: that one's; belonging to that person
entries.notes: M栏尾有残损（[残]）；音节与「许个」及西语 suyo de aquel 对应仍明确。
